description: Show what the signed-in user's approval policy would decide for a planned batch of actions: auto (runs without asking), ask (needs the user's approval) or deny (refused), with the rule ids and reasons. Nothing runs and no limit is used. Use before alterlab_task_act to know whether the batch will pause for approval. Pass the domains, the actions and, per action, its risk class; an action without a class is treated as submit. This tool cannot create or change policies: the user does that in the dashboard.

actions.description: The planned browser actions, as for alterlab_task_act

amount.description: Amount the batch commits, in major units of currency

facts_verified.description: How many written values are backed by verified facts. Default none

risk_classes.description: Risk class per action: navigate, input, draft, submit, message, money, legal_attestation or human_only

name: alterlab_policy_evaluate
title: Evaluate Approval Policy
